title: Generic device model (GDM.lock.json)
description: The generated device model of an application, derived from the device tree and the device descriptions. It is the input for generating the IEC code that drives the I/O. This is a generated build artifact in the application's .intermediate folder and is not meant to be written by hand.

deviceTree.title: Device tree
deviceTree.description: The resolved device tree with the top-level device, its settings, parameters, channels, function blocks and connected sub-devices.

deviceName.title: Device name
deviceName.description: Name of the top-level device instance.

moduleListIndex.title: Module list index
moduleListIndex.description: Index of this device in the flattened module list.

plcSettings.title: PLC settings
plcSettings.description: I/O handling and stop behaviour settings of the PLC.

applicationForIoHandling.title: Application for I/O handling
applicationForIoHandling.description: Name of the application responsible for I/O handling. The code generated from the devices is generated for the application that bears this name.

updateIosInStop.title: Update I/Os in stop
updateIosInStop.description: States if the values of I/Os are also updated when the PLC is in stop mode.

stopResetBehaviour.title: Stop reset behaviour
stopResetBehaviour.description: States the behaviour of the I/Os when the controller enters stop mode.

generateForceVariables.title: Generate force variables
generateForceVariables.description: States if two global variables are created for each I/O, which can be used to force the input or output value of the respective I/O.

showIoWarningsAsErrors.title: Show warnings as errors
showIoWarningsAsErrors.description: States if warnings concerning the I/O configuration are displayed as errors.

deviceDiagnosis.title: Device diagnosis
deviceDiagnosis.description: States if the diagnostics for devices are enabled.

symbolicIoAccess.title: Symbolic I/O access
symbolicIoAccess.description: States if input and output variables are automatically created for the I/O channels of the PLC.

needsBusCycle.title: Needs bus cycle
needsBusCycle.description: States if the device requires a bus cycle.

needsBusCycleBeforeRead.title: Needs bus cycle before read
needsBusCycleBeforeRead.description: States if a bus cycle is required before the inputs are read.

cycleControlInIec.title: Cycle control in IEC
cycleControlInIec.description: States if the bus cycle is controlled from IEC code.

stopResetBehaviourUserProgram.title: Stop reset behaviour user program
stopResetBehaviourUserProgram.description: Name of the program executed when the controller enters stop mode. Only relevant when stopResetBehaviour executes a program.

inputChannelEntries.title: Input channel entries
inputChannelEntries.description: Generated input channel entries of the top-level device.

outputChannelEntries.title: Output channel entries
outputChannelEntries.description: Generated output channel entries of the top-level device.

functionBlocks.title: Function blocks
functionBlocks.description: Function block instances generated for the top-level device.

downwardConnectors.title: Downward connectors
downwardConnectors.description: Connections from the top-level device down to its child devices.

taskConfig.title: Task configuration
taskConfig.description: The tasks referenced by the device model, mapping each task name to its GUID.

typeDefinitions.title: Type definitions
typeDefinitions.description: The generated IEC type definitions referenced by device parameters (by baseType) and channels, keyed by type name. Each value is a type definition discriminated by a `$type` field, one of Enum, Struct, Union, Bitfield, Array or Range; its remaining shape depends on `$type` and is not further constrained by this schema.

settings.title: Device settings
settings.description: Bus and update settings for a device or module.

updateAlways.title: Update always
updateAlways.description: States if variables are always updated, even if not used in a task.

busCycleTask.title: Bus cycle task
busCycleTask.description: Name of the bus cycle task for this device.

createBitChannels.title: Create bit channels
createBitChannels.description: States if individual bit channels are created for the device's I/O.

identification.title: Device identification
identification.description: Identifies the device description this device is based on (numeric type, id and version).

type.title: Type
type.description: Numeric device type from the device description.

id.title: Id
id.description: Device identifier from the device description.

parameter.title: Parameter
parameter.description: A device parameter, its value, access rights and (for I/O channels) its mappings.

id.title: Id
id.description: The parameter id from the device description.

baseType.title: Base type
baseType.description: The IEC base type of the parameter.

parameterValue.title: Parameter value
parameterValue.description: The parameter's value: a scalar value, a structured component list, or null.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: Channel kind and access rights of the parameter.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Whether the parameter is a plain parameter (None) or an I/O channel (Input, Output, OutputReadOnly or Bidirectional).

onlineAccess.title: Online access
onlineAccess.description: Access to the parameter while connected to the controller.

offlineAccess.title: Offline access
offlineAccess.description: Access to the parameter in the editor while offline.

functional.title: Functional
functional.description: True when the parameter is a functional parameter. Omitted when false.

mappings.title: Mappings
mappings.description: The I/O mapping of this channel.

parameterAccessEnum.title: Parameter access
parameterAccessEnum.description: Access right for a parameter: ReadWrite, Read, Write or None.

functionBlock.title: Function block
functionBlock.description: A function block instance generated for the device, including its cyclic method calls.

instanceName.title: Instance name
instanceName.description: Name of the generated function block instance.

fbName.title: Function block name
fbName.description: Name of the function block type.

namespace.title: Namespace
namespace.description: Namespace of the function block type.

initialize.title: Initialize
initialize.description: Name of the method called once on the instance to initialize it. Absent or null when the function block has no initialization method.

fbTypeInputMethod.title: FB type input method
fbTypeInputMethod.description: Whether the function block exposes an input method.

cyclicCalls.title: Cyclic calls
cyclicCalls.description: Method calls invoked cyclically relative to the bus cycle.

methodName.title: Method name
methodName.description: Name of the method to call.

task.title: Task
task.description: Name of the task in which the method is called.

whenToCall.title: When to call
whenToCall.description: When in the I/O cycle the method is called.

upwardConnector.title: Upward connector
upwardConnector.description: The connection from a device up to its parent module.

moduleListIndex.title: Module list index
moduleListIndex.description: Index of the connected module in the module list.

moduleType.title: Module type
moduleType.description: Numeric module type of the connected module.

initialStatusFlag.title: Initial status flag
initialStatusFlag.description: Initial status flag of the connector.

inputChannelEntries.title: Input channel entries
inputChannelEntries.description: Generated input channel entries of the connector.

outputChannelEntries.title: Output channel entries
outputChannelEntries.description: Generated output channel entries of the connector.

downwardConnector.title: Downward connector
downwardConnector.description: A connection from a device down to child devices, either as a list of devices or as indexed slots.

moduleListIndex.title: Module list index
moduleListIndex.description: Index of the connector's module in the module list.

slotCount.title: Slot count
slotCount.description: Number of slots when the connector is slot-based.

moduleType.title: Module type
moduleType.description: Numeric module type of the connector.

initialStatusFlag.title: Initial status flag
initialStatusFlag.description: Initial status flag of the connector.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Child devices connected as an ordered list.

slots.title: Slots
slots.description: Child devices connected by slot, keyed by the numeric slot index.

inputChannelEntries.title: Input channel entries
inputChannelEntries.description: Generated input channel entries of the connector.

outputChannelEntries.title: Output channel entries
outputChannelEntries.description: Generated output channel entries of the connector.

device.title: Device
device.description: A device or module in the model, with its identification, settings, parameters, connectors and channels.

upwardConnector.title: Upward connector
upwardConnector.description: The connection up to the parent module.

inputChannelEntries.title: Input channel entries
inputChannelEntries.description: Generated input channel entries of the device.

outputChannelEntries.title: Output channel entries
outputChannelEntries.description: Generated output channel entries of the device.

mapping.title: Mapping
mapping.description: An I/O mapping of a channel or component to a variable or address, with optional sub-mappings.

mapping.title: Mapping
mapping.description: The variable the channel or component is mapped to.

componentIdentifier.title: Component identifier
componentIdentifier.description: Identifier of the mapped component within the channel.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.description: Names of the tasks in which the mapping is updated.

mappingTypeCategory.title: Mapping type category
mappingTypeCategory.description: The category of the mapped type.

submappings.title: Submappings
submappings.description: Mappings of the nested components of this mapping.

stopResetBehaviourEnum.title: Stop reset behaviour
stopResetBehaviourEnum.description: Behaviour of the outputs when the controller stops.

parameterValue.title: Parameter value
parameterValue.description: A parameter's value: a structured component list, a scalar 'value', or null.

value.title: Value
value.description: The scalar value as a string.

parameterValueComponentList.title: Value components
parameterValueComponentList.description: A list of named value components; each component is either a scalar value or a nested component list.

value.title: Value
value.description: The scalar value of the component as a string.

needsBusCycle.title: Needs bus cycle
needsBusCycle.description: States if the connector requires a bus cycle.

needsBusCycleBeforeRead.title: Needs bus cycle before read
needsBusCycleBeforeRead.description: States if a bus cycle is required before the inputs are read.

GdmChannelEntry.title: Channel entry
GdmChannelEntry.description: A generated input or output channel entry: the mapped variable and the path to the mapped component.

mappedVariable.title: Mapped variable
mappedVariable.description: The IEC variable the channel is mapped to.

mappingType.title: Mapping type
mappingType.description: The type of the mapped variable.

componentPath.title: Component path
componentPath.description: Path to the channel component within the device.

pathToMappedComponent.title: Path to mapped component
pathToMappedComponent.description: Path to the mapped component of the variable.

parameterIndex.title: Parameter index
parameterIndex.description: Index of the parameter this channel belongs to.
